title.en: An Act Establishing a Regular National High School in Barangay Plaridel, Municipality of Libjo, Province of Surigao Del Norte to Be Known as the Plaridel National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a Regular National High School in Barangay Plaridel, Municipality of Libjo, Province of Surigao Del Norte to Be Known as the Plaridel National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường Trung học Plaridel Quốc gia tại Barangay Plaridel, Đô thị Libjo, Tỉnh Surigao Del Norte, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Plaridel แห่งชาติ ในบารังไกย์ Plaridel เทศบาล Libjo จังหวัด Surigao Del Norte และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk Sekolah Menengah Plaridel Nasional di Barangay Plaridel, Kotamadya Libjo, Provinsi Surigao Del Norte, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Plaridel Kebangsaan di Barangay Plaridel, Perbandaran Libjo, Wilayah Surigao Del Norte, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

text.en: There shall be established, under the supervision of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports, a national high school in Barangay Plaridel, Municipality of Libjo, Province of Surigao del Norte to be known as the Plaridel National High School.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
